scope: posthoc descriptive explanation, complete fixed 36 tapes by three declared seeds; not tuning or independent confirmation
denominator: all108 scenario-versus-point pairs and all108 scenario-versus-legacy pairs, plus all36 point-versus-factorial reproduction checks
extremes: For each seed separately select minimum and maximum final actual J difference versus point, sorting ties lexicographically by unit identity. Retain zero or same-signed extrema and label them accurately rather than implying positive/negative examples must exist.
seed_disagreement: Select the unit with largest max-minus-min final J across all three seeds, ties lexicographically. Keep all three seeds including equal cases.
trace_rule: First unequal actual slow physical action at common trigger; bind snapshot SHA, visible forecasts, point proxy, common candidate sequence keys, eight requested scenario tapes and multiplicities, each candidate expected cost, and full actual physical trace.
limitations: If no slow physical difference exists record null; if snapshots/pools differ do not claim same-state choice causality. These examples are extracted only after all144 summary exists; no resimulation, changing prior or choosing a best seed.
